changes: MAJOR: Integrated a Centralized Media Library. All newly uploaded images are now saved to the server and referenced via URLs, drastically reducing article size and preventing database bloat caused by base64 images.
Media Library: Added an Admin Media Manager page to upload, view, search, and delete images.
Media Library: Editor (Quill) and Featured Image tools now use a Media Picker Modal instead of direct uploads, allowing you to reuse existing images.
Dashboard: Redesigned the 'What's New' panel into a compact, single-row horizontal strip to save vertical space.
Categories: Improved Breadcrumbs UI to automatically fetch and display the full parent-child subcategory hierarchy (Home → Parent → Subcategory).
Categories: Parent categories now automatically include and display posts from all their nested subcategories.
Feedback: Converted 'Feedback' label into a dynamic 'Apni Baat' configuration to collect user articles for public review.

Fixed: Theme 2 horizontal nav submenu dropdowns were rendering behind the breaking news ticker bar. Raised nav z-index to 500 and submenu z-index to 9999 to guarantee submenus always appear on top of everything.
Fixed: Added explicit overflow:visible on .t2-has-sub so the parent list item never clips its own dropdown.

Fixed: Breaking news ticker appearing twice on category pages. The global ticker is now suppressed whenever category.php is loaded, since the category page renders its own dedicated category-specific ticker.
Improved submenu box-shadow for a more polished look.
MAJOR: Version milestone bump to v2.2 — Major Dashboard overhaul and new homepage Theme 2 option.
Dashboard: Completely redesigned for better usability — tighter layout, improved typography, and consistent Inter font.
Dashboard: Added 'What's New' panel that dynamically reads from changelog.json and displays last 3 version updates with all change notes.
Dashboard: KPI cards are now clickable links that navigate directly to the related admin section.
Dashboard: Added dedicated 'Themes' quick action button linking to Settings > Appearance.
Dashboard: Added 'Comments' quick action with live pending-count badge.
Dashboard: Added 'Check Updates' and 'Open Website' shortcut buttons below the Quick Actions grid.
Dashboard: Recent Posts now shows article thumbnail instead of a color dot for faster visual recognition.
Dashboard: Version badge shown inline in the greeting banner.
Dashboard: Overall spacing, border radii, and shadow hierarchy refined for a more premium feel.
Complete redesign of the public category page: hero banner with category color, subcategory pills, breadcrumb, and post count stats.
Added category-specific breaking news ticker on the category page showing latest posts from that category.
Added featured lead post hero card (460px height) with dark gradient overlay, view count, and featured badge.
Article grid uses 2-column layout with image zoom, hover lift, and category badge overlay on thumbnail.
Category sidebar added: Most Read (top 5 by views with rank highlights), Sub-Topics quick nav, and Subscribe CTA widget.
Full pagination added to category page (12 posts per page).
Theme 2 horizontal navigation now uses Feather icons from each category's icon setting instead of colored dots.
Theme 2 navigation is now non-sticky (position: relative) — scrolls away with page as requested.
Fixed breaking news bar showing twice on the Theme 2 homepage by suppressing the global breaking bar when Theme 2 is active on index.php.
Removed AI Chat floating button and Feedback drawer from the Settings page to keep it focused on configuration.
Fixed the remaining unclosed div container bug under the AI settings panel to ensure that the settings form save button and other subsequent tabs display correctly across all settings tabs.
Added automatic database migration executor on admin panel page load so that database updates are applied instantly without manual intervention.
Fixed HTML container nesting bugs under the AI settings panel to ensure all settings panels and the main settings form save button render properly.
Fixed an HTML tag nesting bug in admin/settings.php that caused the Interactions settings tab content to remain hidden under the AI settings container.
Implemented hierarchical subcategory management support allowing parent-child associations for categories.
Added support for custom redirect/external URLs for category sidebar navigation links.
Integrated user engagement elements: post commenting and post likes/dislikes rating widgets with cookie-based double-voting protection.
Created a centralized admin Comments Moderation Dashboard for approving, deleting, or flagging user comments as spam.
Added global toggle settings for comments and likes/dislikes under the admin Settings tab.
Expanded category icon list with additional options during category creation/editing.
Added configuration settings for website header branding: show logo only, name only, or both logo and name.
Updated the login screen to dynamically display the custom website logo from settings.
Added a dynamic pending comments counter and badge to the admin sidebar.
Filtered out disabled/inactive categories from all public website queries including category detail page, search queries, tag queries, post details, and homepage sections.
Fixed contact page (contact.php) headquarters address to load dynamically from admin settings.
Dynamicized the admin left sidebar top branding area to pull and display the site name and logo initials directly from dynamic settings.
Implemented auto-optimization, resizing, and WebP conversion for all uploaded post featured images.
Added automatic watermarking to stamp the website URL (cleaned domain and path) in the bottom-right corner of featured image uploads using a custom semi-transparent badge overlay.
Implemented background auto-save (every 30s) for drafts on both new article creation and editing screens.
Restructured settings page to move Google Translate and Voice Reader (TTS) controls into a dedicated 'Voice & Translate' settings tab.
Unified the admin sidebar menu by placing Inbox and Event Timeline under Content section, removing the redundant Activity & Inbox header.
Fixed header overlapping and mobile viewport layout breaks by properly linking the responsive stylesheet 'admin_responsive.css' in the admin header.
Fixed broken 'Auto Draft with AI' link to open the GenAI News Generator side drawer natively.
Defaulted the Publish Schedule input field to the current local date and time.
Enabled Ctrl+V clipboard pasting of featured photos with automatic UI preview.
Enabled on-the-fly slug auto-generation from article titles.
Implemented automated database table creation for WP Sources to prevent fatal database query errors.
Removed Security link from the main sidebar menu.
Added Security link into the top-bar profile hover dropdown menu.
Removed Profile, Help & Docs, and Logout buttons from the bottom of the sidebar.
Added a clean, animated hover dropdown menu to the profile block in the top header bar.
Removed redundant logout icon button from the header.
Fixed CSS positioning bug on the new sidebar that was causing a layout gap.
Fixed CSS layout bug causing a white gap between the new sidebar and the main content area.
Removed obsolete legacy CSS styles that conflicted with the redesigned sidebar.
Complete admin sidebar redesign for improved usability.
Nav items now have icon-wrapped squares with coloured active state and left-border highlight.
Reorganised into 5 logical sections: Overview, Content, Advertising, Team, System.
Added 'New Article' quick-action button at top of sidebar.
Inbox unread count badge moved directly onto the Inbox nav item.
Version badge on System Update item shows current version.
Profile, Help and Logout pinned to bottom of sidebar for easy access.
Sidebar collapses to icon-only mode on narrow screens and remembers state.
Removed redundant ACCOUNT section — merged into bottom fixed area.
Complete professional dashboard redesign with Inter font and CSS custom property design system.
Added personalised greeting banner (Good Morning/Afternoon/Evening) with today's post count and total views.
Expanded to 8 KPI stat cards: Published, Total Views, Ad Clicks, Inbox, Categories, Active Polls, Staff, Active Ads.
KPI cards feature coloured top-bar accent, icon badges, sub-labels, and hover lift animations.
Rank badges (gold/silver/bronze) on Top Articles table for visual hierarchy.
Ad Pulse panel now shows clicks + impressions per ad alongside CTR.
6-icon Quick Actions grid with colour-coded action tiles.
Feedback Inbox now shows unread count badge in card header and message timestamps.
Section Pulse category bars now include category icon badges and glow effects.
Live Stream banner fully integrated and responsive.
Premium UI redesign of Ad Click History page — card-based layout, gradient stat icons, Inter font.
Added IP Geolocation — each click now shows City, Country (with flag emoji), and ISP via ip-api.com.
Added 'Unique Visitors' stat card (distinct IP count).
Colour-coded Ad Slot badges (header, sidebar, content top/bottom, sponsored post).
Fixed system updater showing false 'Update Available' — added db_version 6 migration to run_migrations.php so the settings table syncs correctly.
CSV export now includes City, Country, and ISP geolocation columns.
Added Ad Click History tracking system.
Every ad click now records date, time, IP address, ad location (header/sidebar/content), and event type (ad click vs sponsored post click).
New admin page: Ad Click History with stat cards (Today / 7-Day / 30-Day / All-Time).
Filterable log table by Ad, Event Type, Date Range, and IP Address.
Pagination (25 per page) and CSV Export for click logs.
Per-ad drill-down: View history button added to each ad row in Ad Campaigns.
Click History nav link added to admin sidebar under Growth & PR.
Fixed Admin Panel 'EN/HI' language toggle getting stuck on Hindi on live domains due to aggressive cookie scope rules.
Completely hide the Google Translate top banner on the frontend article viewer.
Refactored the System Updater's internal fetching logic.
The Updater now utilizes the GitHub API rather than Raw Content delivery, permanently bypassing GitHub's 5-minute CDN cache.
Updates will now be detected instantly without any waiting period.
Fixed a JSON syntax issue in the changelog that caused the System Updater to malfunction and not display the latest updates.
Fixed a bug with the Google Translate widget on live servers where reverting to the original language would fail.
Added a dedicated 'Reset' button next to the Translate dropdown that forcefully clears language cookies across all domain scopes.
Added 'Poll of the Day' and 'Events of the Day' widgets to the single news article sidebar.
Removed E-Paper link from the public footer.
Added an interactive 'Poll of the Day' widget to the homepage sidebar.
Integrated seamless AJAX voting and dynamic real-time progress bars for poll results.
Overhauled the System Updater UI with a premium look.
Added a dynamic GitHub Changelog viewer that fetches the latest release history directly from the cloud.
Fixed 500 Internal Server Error during AI Image Generation by switching to the default stable model.
Added Bulk Delete feature in Article Management table.

Added missing 'show_on_homepage' schema migration for live installations.
Updated newscast_db.sql for fresh installations.

Refactored Category list to use direct toggles for Status and Homepage Visibility.
Cleaned up Category Edit Modal by removing redundant switch.
Implemented Automated WP Syndication Engine.
Added WP Sources CRUD Manager to Admin Panel.
Added zero-duplicate protection using source_url mapping.
Created background 'Poor Man's Cron' trigger for passive 30-min syncs.
Restored Manual Import tool with Live Progress UI and Quick Select.
System Updater improvements and DB verification fixes.
Ensured robust database schema checks during updates.
Major UI/UX Settings Redesign for Livestream & Appearance tabs.
Added floating WhatsApp widget and options to hide footer contact details.

Performance optimizations and minor bug fixes.
